data:
@CategoryTheory.RegularEpi.{u_1,
    u_2} : {C : Type u_2} →
  [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} C] →
    {X Y : C} →
      @Quiver.Hom.{u_1, u_2} C
          (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{u_1, u_2} C
            (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{u_1, u_2} C inst))
          X Y →
        Type (max u_2 u_1)

@CategoryTheory.regularEpiOfKernelPair.{u_1,
    u_2} : {C : Type u_2} →
  [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} C] →
    {B X : C} →
      (f :
          @Quiver.Hom.{u_1, u_2} C
            (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{u_1, u_2} C
              (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{u_1, u_2} C inst))
            X B) →
        [inst_1 : @CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullback.{u_1, u_2} C inst X X B f f] →
          @CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit.{0, u_1, 0, u_2} CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingParallelPair
              CategoryTheory.Limits.walkingParallelPairHomCategory C inst
              (@CategoryTheory.Limits.parallelPair.{u_1, u_2} C
                (@CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.{u_1, u_2} C inst X X B f f inst_1) X inst
                (@CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst.{u_1, u_2} C inst X X B f f inst_1)
                (@CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.snd.{u_1, u_2} C inst X X B f f inst_1))
              (@CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofork.ofπ.{u_1, u_2} C
                (@CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.{u_1, u_2} C inst X X B f f inst_1) X inst
                (@CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst.{u_1, u_2} C inst X X B f f inst_1)
                (@CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.snd.{u_1, u_2} C inst X X B f f inst_1) B f ⋯) →
            @CategoryTheory.RegularEpi.{u_1, u_2} C inst X B f

@CategoryTheory.regularEpiOfEffectiveEpi.{u_1,
    u_2} : {C : Type u_2} →
  [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} C] →
    {B X : C} →
      (f :
          @Quiver.Hom.{u_1, u_2} C
            (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{u_1, u_2} C
              (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{u_1, u_2} C inst))
            X B) →
        [@CategoryTheory.Limits.HasPullback.{u_1, u_2} C inst X X B f f] →
          [@CategoryTheory.EffectiveEpi.{u_1, u_2} C inst B X f] → @CategoryTheory.RegularEpi.{u_1, u_2} C inst X B f

@CategoryTheory.RegularEpi.ofSplitEpi.{u_1,
    u_2} : {C : Type u_2} →
  [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, u_2} C] →
    {X Y : C} →
      (f :
          @Quiver.Hom.{u_1, u_2} C
            (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver.{u_1, u_2} C
              (@CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct.{u_1, u_2} C inst))
            X Y) →
        [@CategoryTheory.IsSplitEpi.{u_1, u_2} C inst X Y f] → @CategoryTheory.RegularEpi.{u_1, u_2} C inst X Y f
